mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm really glad you're here. Imagine growing up surrounded by Hollywood lights, yet still feeling the pull of wide-open prairies and the honest simplicity of the American heartland. That’s the world we’re about to step into together, as we follow the journey shaped by both childhood fame and the everyday challenges of finding out who you really are. In "Prairie Tale," Melissa Gilbert shares her story—one that begins on the unforgettable set of "Little House on the Prairie," then moves bravely through the unpredictable twists of adulthood. Behind the scenes of television magic, there’s a real person wrestling with questions about belonging, self-worth, and what it truly means to be home. You’ll feel the highs of joy and success, the sting of heartbreak, and the steady determination it takes to face personal struggles head-on. As Melissa’s story unfolds over decades, we’ll explore moments of love, addiction, and reinvention—each one adding a new layer to the woman behind that familiar smile. Family, in all its beautiful and messy forms, offers comfort one moment and conflict the next. Through raw honesty and real vulnerability, what shines through is a universal longing—to belong, to be understood, and to finally accept ourselves, flaws and all. So, as we set out on this journey together, let’s keep our hearts open. There’s a lot to discover—not just about a beloved actress, but about what it means to embrace every chapter of your own life.
